name: io.github.jlgavel011/sellbase
title: Sellbase
description: Open source commerce in your own Supabase: catalog, checkout, orders and bookings, run by your AI.

environmentVariables.name: SELLBASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Your store API: <SUPABASE_URL>/functions/v1/sellbase-api. `npx sellbase init` writes it to .env.sellbase, which the server also reads.

environmentVariables.name: SELLBASE_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Agent token (sb_live_…) with the scopes the owner granted. Create one with `npx sellbase token create` or in Admin → Settings → AI agents.

environmentVariables.name: SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Supabase anon/publishable key (public). Needed for storefront tools on hosted projects.
